'''Ma Yanming''' (born September 1972) is a Chinese physicist and an [[Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences|academician]] of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. His research area focuses on [[Computational physics|computational]] [[condensed matter physics]] under high-pressure conditions. He is currently the President and Deputy [[Chinese Communist Party|Party]] Secretary of [[Zhejiang University]]. He previously served as Vice President of [[Jilin University]].

== Biography ==
Born in [[Antu County]], [[Jilin|Jilin Province]] in September 1972, Ma Yanming was admitted to the Department of Physics at [[Yanbian University]] in 1991, where he obtained his bachelor's and master's degrees. In 1998, he pursued further studies at the State Key Laboratory of Superhard Materials at [[Jilin University]] under the supervision of [[Zou Guangtian]], one of the founders of [[high-pressure physics]] in China. After graduating in 2001, he remained at the university as a faculty member. He was promoted to professor in 2005. In 2011, he was appointed a Distinguished Professor under the [[Changjiang Scholars Program]]. From 2017 to 2021, he served as Dean of the School of Physics at Jilin University. In September 2021, he became Vice President of Jilin University.<ref>{{cite web |date=2018-10-10 |title=我很享受探索的乐趣 |url=http://edu.people.com.cn/n1/2018/1010/c1006-30331271.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231122133534/http://edu.people.com.cn/n1/2018/1010/c1006-30331271.html |archive-date=2023-11-22 |access-date=2023-11-22 |website=People's Daily Online}}</ref><ref name="icfs">{{cite web |title=马琰铭教授 |url=https://icfs.jlu.edu.cn/info/1041/2853.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231122133540/https://icfs.jlu.edu.cn/info/1041/2853.htm |archive-date=2023-11-22 |access-date=2023-11-22 |website=Jilin University}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=2017-06-19 |title=耕耘 记吉大超硬材料国家重点实验室教授马琰铭 |url=https://jl.chinadaily.com.cn/2017-06/19/content_29792350.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231122133538/https://jl.chinadaily.com.cn/2017-06/19/content_29792350.htm |archive-date=2023-11-22 |access-date=2023-11-22 |website=China Daily}}</ref> On 22 November 2023, he was elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.<ref>{{cite web |date=2023-11-22 |title=刚刚揭晓！吉林新增2位院士 |url=http://www.jl.xinhuanet.com/20231122/f11865bc65c94c56ad5491f8f94b8f3f/c.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231123024839/http://www.jl.xinhuanet.com/20231122/f11865bc65c94c56ad5491f8f94b8f3f/c.html |archive-date=2023-11-23 |access-date=2023-11-22 |website=Xinhua Net}}</ref> On 28 March 2025, he was appointed President and Deputy Party Secretary of Zhejiang University.<ref>{{Cite web |title=马琰铭同志任浙江大学校长 |url=http://www.moe.gov.cn/jyb_xwfb/gzdt_gzdt/s5987/202503/t20250328_1185237.html |access-date=2025-03-28 |website=Ministry of Education}}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==

* Member of [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (2023)
* The second-class prize of the [[State Natural Science Award]] (2019), [[State Council of China]]
* Highly Cited Researcher (2017–2023), [[Clarivate|Clarivate Analytics]]
* Walter Kohn Prize (2016), [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] in [[Trieste]]
* China Youth Science and Technology Award (2011)
* GRC Jamieson Award (2001), International Association for High Pressure Science and Technology<ref name="icfs" /><ref>{{cite web |date=2016-12-19 |title=马琰铭获首届沃尔特·科恩（Walter Kohn）奖 |url=https://news.jlu.edu.cn/info/1021/43879.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231122133535/https://news.jlu.edu.cn/info/1021/43879.htm |archive-date=2023-11-22 |access-date=2023-11-22 |website=Jilin University}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=2016-12-13 |title=7人获吉林省青年科技奖 马琰铭获得特别奖 |url=https://news.jlu.edu.cn/info/1021/43855.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231122133821/https://news.jlu.edu.cn/info/1021/43855.htm |archive-date=2023-11-22 |access-date=2023-11-22 |website=Jilin University}}</ref>
